limitations:
Development-only MSVC C API/error-boundary proof against official Lua 5.1.

This does not enable production package.loadlib or provide a complete C API.
It tests persistent per-thread C states, a small API subset and C-only error jumps while
the Rust engine uses panic=abort. No C Lua implementation executes Rust cases.
 The probe uses VM-owned stacks, persistent C states, unprotected calls, private owned function bindings, up to 255 actual C upvalues and Lua 5.1 pseudo-indexes, aligned stable userdata payloads, environments and NUL-terminated string conversions, plus protected calls and error functions, scalar conversions, comparison and native-window concatenation, formatted messages, auxiliary checks/registration/references and auxiliary buffers/literal replacement. Cross-thread/inactive-state API access, complete C APIs, production library caching/unload, package.loadlib and require integration remain unfinished. Native reader/buffer/string loading is a development subset: the independent parser_scratch_probe retains the observable lua_gettop mismatch from PUC parser roots. luaL_loadfile, allocator/OOM statuses, full native loader/C API parity and production loading remain unfinished.
